title: Refactor Note Detail State Architecture
summary: This session resolved state synchronization issues in the NoteDetail layout by introducing a dedicated Zustand UI slice and isolating API-driven Server Data Context. The team agreed to separate transient UI state from persistent server data to eliminate re-render cascades.

topics.name: State Duplication
topics.insight: Avoid maintaining duplicate note selection lists in both local workspace context and global Redux store. Single source of truth reduces sync bugs.

topics.name: Audio Player Sync
topics.insight: Keep audio controls inside the local view controller to prevent unnecessary parent component re-renders. Audio state is inherently transient.

topics.name: Server Data Caching
topics.insight: React Query provides built-in deduplication and stale-while-revalidate. No need for a custom caching layer on top.

decisions.decision: Isolate UI states like collapse-expand toggles into a tab.slice.ts Zustand slice.
decisions.reason: Zustand slices allow fine-grained, selector-based renders without the boilerplate of Redux or the context-invalidation cascades of React Context.

decisions.decision: Retain server-fetched model data in the existing NoteDetailContext.
decisions.reason: Allows us to keep existing data-fetching logic and hook caching in place without risk of regressions.

decisions.decision: Use React Query for all new API integrations instead of custom fetch wrappers.
decisions.reason: React Query handles caching, retry, deduplication, and background refetching out of the box. Reduces custom code by ~60%.

actionItems.task: Migrate SidePanel component to select from the new Zustand store
Write integration tests for NoteDetail state transitions

openQuestions: Should audio state eventually be moved to a shared Zustand media slice?
Do we need to support offline mode for NoteDetail in the first iteration?
unresolvedConflicts: Disagreement over whether tab state should be synchronized with the URL hash parameters for bookmarking.
